_comment_purpose: The runtime layer's permissions and hook enforcers for a platform monorepo, composed from the settings snippets the vendored modules ship. Each block names its source so a re-vendor is a diff: deny = git-flow-no-direct-main + git-flow-session-end (the trio VENDORING.md §6 bakes in), stay-in-project-tree/settings-snippet.json, no-sudo-as-shortcut/settings-snippet.json; hooks = session-handoff/settings-snippet.json, git-flow-session-end/settings-snippet.json, and the re-read guard block from templates/_shared/claude-settings.example.json (no-cat-head-via-bash). The allow list is this repo's own and is the factory's contract: a headless runner job passes it through, and anything left at ask is a refusal in a headless run. Lint right after any merge (VENDORING.md §6): run a fresh `claude -p "read /etc/hostname"` from the repo root and read its stderr for rules it could not parse, then trip one deny and see it refused. A seatless user needs none of this file; the platform layer (branch permissions, PR template, CI) enforces the same rules.
_comment_allow: Day-to-day autonomy and the factory's contract. Read-only shell, the repo's two verifiers, feature-branch git, and a push of the agent's own branch (-u origin <branch>; the default branch is denied below, and deny wins). Add each business area's verify command from the Areas table in AGENTS.md as its own entry. No host CLI is assumed: on a host with one (gh, glab, ...), allow its read-only and pr-create forms here and deny its merge form below.

permissions._comment_ask: Anything that mutates a remote beyond the agent's own branch or destroys local state. In a headless run every one of these is a refusal, so a runner job must not need them.
permissions._comment_deny: Three sources. (1) The git-flow deny trio from VENDORING.md §6: no push to the default branch, no force push, no merge from the agent; the human merges in the host's UI. Rename `main` if the default branch is called something else. (2) stay-in-project-tree/settings-snippet.json: nothing outside the project tree, no credential stores, no shell rc or global agent config, no remote shells or schedulers. (3) no-sudo-as-shortcut/settings-snippet.json: no elevation, no root inside containers. Re-vendor by replacing a block with the snippet's current deny array.

_comment_hooks: Each hook runs a script a vendored module ships under modules/<name>/ and is guarded with `[ -f ] || exit 0`, so every entry is a safe no-op until install-modules.sh brings that module from the meta-repo, and every script fails open. SessionStart (session-handoff): surfaces the committed .claude/next-session.md into the opening context; disable for one session with SESSION_HANDOFF_KICKOFF_DISABLED=1. Stop (git-flow-session-end): nudges the agent back onto the session-end loop when it ends a turn with a merged PR un-cleaned-up or an open PR at the hand-off point; SESSION_END_GUARD_DISABLED=1. PreToolUse on Bash (git-flow-session-end): a one-time reminder when a PR is created with no wrap-up surface loaded; it keys on `gh pr create` and is inert on a host without gh; WRAPUP_NUDGE_DISABLED=1. PreToolUse on Read|Edit|Write|MultiEdit (no-cat-head-via-bash): blocks a redundant re-read of an unmodified file; H2_REREAD_GUARD_DISABLED=1. Before pasting: if the seat holder's own ~/.claude/settings.json already wires one of these, leave that block out here and record why in MODULES.md's Override column, or the hook fires twice (VENDORING.md §6). A managed policy that forbids hooks: delete this block; enforcement stays with the platform layer.
